resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Arithmetic Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Go supports all of the common arithmetic operators.

[s0l0!-header][b]Some examples:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3305"]x := 42
y := 8
      
// Addition
res := x + y
fmt.Println(res)
      
// Subtraction
res = x - y
fmt.Println(res)
      
// Multiplication
res = x * y
fmt.Println(res)
      
// Division
res = x / y
fmt.Println(res)
      
// Modulus, results in the remainder of the division
res = x % y
fmt.Println(res) [/code]
The plus operator + can also be used to add together strings.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3306"]x := "hello "
y  := "world"
fmt.Println(x + y) [/code]
[note]The process of adding together strings is called [b]string concatenation[/b].[/note]

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Assignment Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Go supports short assignment operators, which allow you to replace statements such as [b]x = x+ y[/b], with a shorter version: [b]x += y[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]Some examples:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3307"]x := 42
y := 8

x += y
fmt.Println(x)
    
x *= y
fmt.Println(x)[/code]
[note]There are also short assignment operators for the other arithmetic operators, such as subtraction, division, modulo.[/note]

content.text:
Go支持短赋值运算符，它允许你用更简洁的语法来替换诸如**x = x+ y**这样的语句：**x += y**。

**一些例子：**
content.text_html:
Go supports short assignment operators, which allow you to replace statements such as x = x+ y, with a shorter version: x += y.

Some examples:

Go支持短赋值运算符，它允许你用更短的版本来替换诸如x = x+ y这样的语句。x += y。

一些例子：

content.short_content:
x += y
fmt.Println(x)

x *= y
fmt.Println(x)
content.content:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
  x := 42
  y := 8

  x += y
  fmt.Println(x)
    
  x *= y
  fmt.Println(x)
}

content.text: 其他算术运算符（如减法、除法、模法）也短赋值运算符。
content.text_html:
There are also short assignment operators for the other arithmetic operators, such as subtraction, division, modulo.

还有其他算术运算符的短赋值运算符，如减法、除法、模法。

resolved.title: 物品包装
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你在一家包装公司工作，需要编写一个程序来计算最后一个箱子里会包装多少件物品？

假设一个箱子可以装7件物品，总共有1081件物品需要包装。

你的程序需要计算最后一个箱子里还会有多少物品。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Packaging[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You work at a packaging company and need to create a program to calculate how many items will be packaged in the last box of a shipment.
A box fits 7 items. You have 1081 items to package for the shipment. 

Your program needs to calculate and output how many items will remain the last box after you package them in boxes of 7 items.
[note]Recall the [b]modulo operator --[/b] it can be used to get the remainder after division.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 回顾一下**模运算符**--它可以获取除法后的余数。
